description: This Java class 'MerchantLogDaoImpl' is a Data Access Object (DAO) implementation for handling 'MerchantLog' entities. It extends a generic DAO implementation 'SalesManagerEntityDaoImpl' and implements 'MerchantLogDao'. The class includes an overridden method 'listByMerchant' meant to retrieve logs associated with a specific merchant store, though the actual query implementation is commented out.

classes.name: MerchantLogDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MerchantLogDao, extending a generic DAO for MerchantLog entities, annotated as a Spring Repository.

methods.name: listByMerchant
methods.description: Supposed to return a list of MerchantLog entries associated with a specific MerchantStore; currently returns null, with the query logic commented out.
